auth_body: Sign in to your Pinkall workspace to access your calls, prospects, and coaching.
auth_invite_only: Pinkall is currently available by invitation only.
auth_unavailable_body: This Pinkall build is not connected to a secure workspace yet.
auth_error_network: Unable to connect. Check your network and try again.
auth_error_unknown: Sign-in did not complete. Try again in a moment.
home_subtitle: Call without taking notes. Pinkall remembers the conversation for you.
home_real_calls_only: Transcript and debrief after every call
workspace_context_body: This permanent brief gives the coach your pitch, target and strategy. It complements each call-specific briefing.
workspace_context_pitch_hint: Describe the problem, target, value proposition, proof, offer, differentiation, common objections, CTA and desired tone.
workspace_context_too_large: The presentation must be smaller than 16 KB.
workspace_context_file_error: The presentation could not be opened.
workspace_context_save_error: The context could not be saved. Try again.
telnyx_config_body: Use a short-lived WebRTC token or the SIP credentials from a Telnyx Credential Connection.
telnyx_security_note: Pinkall requests microphone access only when you call or answer. Your credentials are never stored and are sent only to Telnyx.
telnyx_ready_body: Enter a number or find a prospect.
preparation_body: Tell Pinkall the call objective, prospect context, and what you want to achieve. The coach and debrief will adapt to it.
preparation_placeholder:
# Objective
Book a discovery meeting.

# Context
The prospect currently uses…

# Points to explore
- Their current process
- The cost of the problem
preparation_too_large: The briefing must be smaller than 32 KB.
preparation_invalid_file: This is not a valid UTF-8 Markdown document.
preparation_file_error: The file could not be opened.
preparation_data_notice: Pinkall treats this content as call context, never as a system instruction.
voice_dictation_project_hint: Speak naturally about your product, customers, and strategy.
voice_dictation_call_hint: Explain the goal, stakes, and what the coach should watch for.
voice_dictation_starting_hint: Pinkall is preparing a private listening session for this briefing.
voice_dictation_stop_hint: Tap here when you are finished.
voice_dictation_processing_hint: The text stays fully editable before Pinkall uses it.
voice_dictation_added: Transcript added. Review it or keep writing freely.
voice_dictation_permission: Allow microphone access in system settings, then try again.
voice_dictation_no_audio: I did not hear enough speech. Try again and speak a little longer.
voice_dictation_too_long: This dictation is too long. Record a shorter version and try again.
voice_dictation_text_too_large: This transcript would exceed the briefing size limit.
voice_dictation_unavailable: The microphone could not start. Check the selected input device and try again.
voice_dictation_transcription_failed: Transcription did not finish. Your existing text is safe; you can try again.
call_leave_body: The call is still in progress. Leaving this screen will hang up.
call_leave_failed_body: The end of the call was not confirmed. Pinkall can disconnect before leaving.
call_transcription_pending_body: Pinkall starts listening when the conversation begins.
validation_phone: Enter a valid international phone number.
error_microphone: Allow microphone access in system settings, then try again.
error_body: Check your connection, then try again.
progress_subtitle: Pinkall compares your recent calls with the previous ones, without inventing an overall score.
progress_coverage_count: {} of {} calls have a complete debrief
progress_empty_title: Your progress will appear after your first calls.
progress_empty_body: Complete a call with a transcript and debrief to create your first baseline.
progress_baseline: One more call is needed before Pinkall can compare your progress.
progress_radar_subtitle: The shape matters more than an average: each axis represents a different behavior.
progress_focus_body: Work on this axis first during your next call.
progress_strength_body: Keep this behavior while working on your priority.
progress_metrics_subtitle: Measurements calculated from the transcript and speaking times, not estimated by AI.
progress_trend_subtitle: Each point represents an analyzed call.
incoming_calls_status_unsupported: Rings only while the app is open
incoming_calls_body_ready: Push delivery and the system call screen are genuinely configured on this device.
incoming_calls_body_registering: Pinkall is waiting for a valid APNS VoIP or FCM token.
incoming_calls_body_configuration_requir: The code exists, but native capabilities or provider credentials are not configured yet.
incoming_calls_body_disabled: This capability stays gated until Apple, Google and Telnyx setup is complete.
incoming_calls_body_unsupported: On desktop, Pinkall receives calls while the application remains open and connected.
incoming_calls_body_error: Pinkall will not claim background ringing while this check fails.
incoming_calls_body_android_ui_pending: FCM is ready, but the Android background incoming-call UI still needs completion.
